title: UK–EU original question-code survey misfiled under Europolis
row_unit: One original source record; original order retained.
notes: 900 unique sn serials match UK–EU1995 caseid, not Europolis2009. Original q/r/qq/rr question-code versions, authored weights and original group assignments are retained unchanged. Sex1/2 maps exactly to public0/1; all234 positive groups agree. Field b21b records whether a telephone number was given/refused, not the telephone number itself. b22d is a numeric interviewer code despite label INTERVIEWER NAME; no text/contact columns occur. Current canonical inputs remain unchanged.
